verses.geez:
ወአግብር ፡ ቤተ ፡ ምሥዋዕ ፡ እምዕ[ፅ ፡ ዘ]ኢይነቀዝ ፡ ዘኅምስ ፡ በእመት ፡ ኑኁ ፡ ወኅምስ ፡ በእመት ፡ ፅፍኁ ፤
                  ርቡዐ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ምሥዋዑ ፤ ወሥልስ ፡ በእመት ፡ ይኩን ፡ ቆሙ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt make an altar of incorruptible wood, of five cubits in the length, and five cubits in the breadth; the altar shall be square, and the height of it shall be of three cubits.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt make an altar of incorruptible wood, of five cubits in the length, and five cubits in the breadth; the altar shall be square, and the height of it shall be of three cubits.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
translations.ron: "Să faci un jertfelnic din lemn de salcâm, lung de cinci coţi, lat de cinci coţi. Jertfelnicul să fie în patru colţuri şi înălţimea lui de trei coţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσεις θυσιαστήριον ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων, πέντε πήχεων τὸ μῆκος, καὶ πέντε πήχεων τὸ εὖρος· τετράγωνον ἔσται τὸ θυσιαστήριον, καὶ τριῶν πήχεων τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወአግብር ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ወትገብሩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አቅርንተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፬መኣዝኒሁ ፤ ውስቴቱ ፡ ይፃእ ፡ አቅርንቲሆን ፡
                  ወቅፍልዎ ፡ በብርት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the horns on the four corners; the horns shall be of the same piece, and thou shalt overlay them with brass.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt make the horns on the four corners; the horns shall be of the same piece, and thou shalt overlay them with brass.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
translations.ron: În cele patru colţuri ale lui să faci coarne. Coarnele să fie ca răsărite din el şi să-l îmbraci cu aramă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσεις τὰ κέρατα ἐπὶ τῶν τεσσάρων γωνιῶν· ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔσται τὰ κέρατα, καὶ καλύψεις αὐτὰ χαλκῷ.

verses.geez:
ወግበር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ቀጸላ ፡ ለመሥዋዕት ፡ [ወ]ምስዋሪሃ ፡ ወፍያላቲሃ ፡ ወመኈሥሠ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ወመስወደ ፡ እሳት ፤ ኵሎ ፡
                  ትገብር ፡ ዘብርት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a rim for the altar; and its covering and its cups, and its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pan, and all its vessels shalt thou make of brass.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt make a rim for the altar; and its covering and its cups, and its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pan, and all its vessels shalt thou make of brass.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
translations.ron: Apoi să-i faci căldări pentru pus cenuşa, lopăţele, lighene, furculiţe şi cleşte. Toate uneltele acestea să le faci de aramă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσεις στεφάνην τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ· καὶ τὸν καλυπτῆρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰς φιάλας αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰς κρεάγρας αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ πυρεῖον αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ποιήσεις χαλκᾶ.

verses.geez:
ወአግብር ፡ መጥበስቶ ፡ ሠቅሠቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ መሥገርተ ፡ ዐሣ ፡ ዘብርት ፡ ወአግብር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ለመጥበስት ፡ ፬ሕለቃተ ፡
                  አጻብዕ ፡ ዘብርት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፬መኣዝኒሁ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for it a brazen grate with net-work; and thou shalt make for the grate four brazen rings under the four sides.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt make for it a brazen grate with net-work; and thou shalt make for the grate four brazen rings under the four sides.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
translations.ron: Să faci jertfelnicului o împletitură, un fel de cămaşă din sârmă de aramă, şi la împletitura aceasta să faci, în cele patru colţuri ale ei, patru inele de aramă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσεις αὐτῷ ἐσχάραν ἔργῳ δικτυωτῷ χαλκῆν· καὶ ποιήσεις τῇ ἐσχάρᾳ τέσσαρες δακτυλίους χαλκοῦς ὑπὸ τὰ τέσσαρα κλίτη.

verses.geez: ወታነብሮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጥበስት ፡ ዘቤተ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ታሕተ ፡ ወይኩን ፡ መጥበስቱ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መሥዋዕት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt put them below under the grate of the altar, and the grate shall extend to the middle of the altar.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt put them below under the grate of the altar, and the grate shall extend to the middle of the altar.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
translations.ron: Să îmbraci cu cămaşa aceasta partea de jos a jertfelnicului, ca să fie împletitura până la jumătatea jertfelnicului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὑποθήσεις αὐτοὺς ὑπὸ τὴν ἐσχάραν τοῦ θυσιαστήριου κάτωθεν· ἔσται δὲ ἡ ἐσχάρα ἕως τοῦ ἡμίσους τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου.

verses.geez: ወግበር ፡ መጻውርተ ፡ እምዕ[ፅ ፡ ዘ]ኢይነቅዝ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ወትቀፍሎሙ ፡ ብርተ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for the altar staves of incorruptible wood, and thou shalt overlay them with brass.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt make for the altar staves of incorruptible wood, and thou shalt overlay them with brass.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
translations.ron: Să faci pentru jertfelnic pârghii, din lemn de salcâm, şi să le îmbraci cu aramă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσεις τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ ἀναφορεῖς ἐκ ξύλων ἀσήπτων, καὶ περιχαλκώσεις αὐτοὺς χαλκῷ.

verses.geez: ወታብእ ፡ መጽወርተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕለቃት ፡ ወይኩን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ ገበዋተ ፡ መሥዋዕት ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይጸውርዋ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings; and let the staves be on the sides of the altar to carry it.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings; and let the staves be on the sides of the altar to carry it.
translations.kjv: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
translations.ron: Drugii aceştia să-i vâri prin inele, pe o parte şi pe alta a jertfelnicului, ca să poată fi purtat.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰσάξεις τοὺς ἀναφορεῖς εἰς τοὺς δακτυλίους· καὶ ἔστωσαν ἀναφορεῖς κατὰ πλευρὰ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ἐν τῷ αἴρειν αὐτό.

verses.geez: ፍሉገ ፡ ይኩን ፡ ሰሊዳ[ሁ] ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ትገብርዎ ፡ በከመ ፡ አርአይኩክሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብር ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ግበር ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt make it hollow with boards: according to what was shewed thee in the mount, so thou shalt make it.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt make it hollow with boards: according to what was shewed thee in the mount, so thou shalt make it.
translations.kjv: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
translations.ron: Iar jertfelnicul să-l faci de scânduri, gol înăuntru. După cum ţi s-a arătat în munte, aşa să-l faci.
translations.grk: Κοῖλον συνιδωτὸν ποιήσεις αὐτό· κατὰ τὸ παραδειχθέν σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει, οὕτω ποιήσεις αὐτό.

verses.geez:
ወግበር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ለደብተራ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መስመክ ፡ ዘገጸ ፡ ዐረብ ፡ ምንደደ ፡ ለዐጸድ ፡ እምብሰስ ፡ ዕፁፍ ፡
                  ወኑኃ ፡ ምእት ፡ በእመት ፡ እምአሐዱ ፡ መስመክ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a court for the tabernacle, curtains of the court of fine linen spun on the south side, the length of a hundred cubits for one side.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt make a court for the tabernacle, curtains of the court of fine linen spun on the south side, the length of a hundred cubits for one side.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
translations.ron: Cortului să-i faci curte. Pe partea dinspre miazăzi, perdelele să fie de în răsucit, lungi de o sută de coti numai pe partea aceasta.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσεις αὐλὴν τῇ σκηνῇ· εἰς τὸ κλίτος τὸ πρὸς Λίβα ἱστία τῆς αὐλῆς ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης· μῆκος ἑκατὸν πήχεων τῷ ἑνὶ κλίτει.

verses.geez: ወአዕማዲሁ ፡ ፳ወመዓምዲሁ ፡ ዘብርት ፡ ፳ወኍጻዳቲሁ ፡ ወጥነፊሁ ፡ ዘብሩር ።
verses.translation: And their pillars twenty, and twenty brazen sockets for them, and their rings and their clasps of silver.

translations.lxx: And their pillars twenty, and twenty brazen sockets for them, and their rings and their clasps of silver.
translations.kjv: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
translations.ron: Pentru ele să faci douăzeci de stâlpi şi pentru ei douăzeci de postamente de aramă; cârligele la stâlpi şi verigile lor să fie de argint.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ στύλοι αὐτῶν εἴκοσι, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν εἴκοσι χαλκαῖ, καὶ οἱ κρίκοι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ ψαλίδες ἀργυραῖ.

verses.geez:
ከመዝ ፡ ለይትገበር ፡ ለመስመክ ፡ ዘመንጸረ ፡ ምዕዋን ፡ ምንዳዱ ፡ ምእት ፡ በእመት ፡ ኑኁ ፤ አዕማዲሁ ፡ ፳[ወምዕማዲሁ
                  ፡ ፳]ዘብርት ፤ ኍጻዳቲሁ ፡ ወጥነፊሁ ፡ ለዐምድ ፡ ወመዓምዲሁ ፡ ይትቀፈል ፡ በብሩር ።
verses.translation: Thus shall there be to the side toward the north curtains of a hundred cubits in length; and their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty of brass, and the rings and the clasps of the pillars, and their sockets overlaid with silver.

translations.lxx: Thus shall there be to the side toward the north curtains of a hundred cubits in length; and their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty of brass, and the rings and the clasps of the pillars, and their sockets overlaid with silver.
translations.kjv: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
translations.ron: Tot aşa şi pe latura dinspre miazănoapte să fie perdele de o sută de coţi în lungime şi la ele douăzeci de stâlpi, iar sub ei douăzeci de postamente de aramă; cârligele şi verigile stâlpilor să fie de argint.
translations.grk: Οὕτως τῷ κλίτει τῷ πρὸς ἀπηλιώτην ἱστία ἑκατὸν πήχεων μῆκος· καὶ οἱ στύλοι αὐτῶν εἴκοσι, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν εἴκοσι χαλκαῖ· καὶ οἱ κρίκοι καὶ αἱ ψαλίδες τῶν στύλων, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν περιηργυρωμέναι ἀργυρίῳ.

verses.geez: ወፅፍኀ ፡ ዐ[ጸ]ዱ ፡ ዘገጸ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ለምንዳድ ፡ ፶በእመት ፤ ዐምዶሙ ፡ ዐምደ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወምዕማዶሙ ፡ ፲ ።
verses.translation: And in the breadth of the tabernacle toward the west curtains of fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their sockets ten.

translations.lxx: And in the breadth of the tabernacle toward the west curtains of fifty cubits, their pillars ten and their sockets ten.
translations.kjv: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
translations.ron: În latul curţii, pe partea dinspre asfinţit, să fie perdelele lungi de cincizeci de coţi şi la ele zece stâlpi şi la stâlpi zece postamente.
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ εὖρος τῆς αὐλῆς τὸ κατὰ θάλασσαν ἱστία πεντήκοντα πήχεων· στύλοι αὐτῶν δέκα, καὶ βάσεις αὐτῶν δέκα.

verses.geez: ወፅፍኀ ፡ ዐጸዱ ፡ ዘገጸ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ፶በእመት ፤ ዐምዶሙ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወምዕማዶሙ ፡ ፲ ።
verses.translation: And in the breadth of the tabernacle toward the south, curtains of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

translations.lxx: And in the breadth of the tabernacle toward the south, curtains of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
translations.kjv: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
translations.ron: Tot de cincizeci de coţi să fie perdelele din latul curţii în partea dinainte, cea dinspre răsărit; şi la ele zece stâlpi şi sub ei zece postamente.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὖρος τῆς αὐλῆς τῆς πρὸς Νότον ἱστία πεντήκοντα πήχεων· στύλοι αὐτῶν δέκα, καὶ βάσεις αὐτῶν δέκα.

verses.geez: ወዕሥር ፡ ወኅምስ ፡ በእመት ፡ ዘምንዳድ ፡ ኑኁ ፡ እምገጸ ፡ ፩መስመክት ፤ ዐምዶሙ ፡ ሠለስቱ ፡ ምዕማዶሙ ፡ ሠለስቱ ።
verses.translation: And the height of the curtains shall be of fifteen cubits for the one side of the gate; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

translations.lxx: And the height of the curtains shall be of fifteen cubits for the one side of the gate; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translations.kjv: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translations.ron: Din aceştia, cincisprezece coţi la un capăt al laturii să fie perdelele, cu trei stâlpi ai lor şi cu trei postamente,
translations.grk: Καὶ πεντεκαίδεκα πήχεων τὸ ὕψος τῶν ἱστίων τῷ κλίτει τῷ ἑνί· στύλοι αὐτῶν τρεῖς, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τρεῖς.

verses.geez: ወእምካልእ ፡ መስመክት ፡ ፲ወ፭በእመት ፡ ለምንዳድ ፡ ቆሙ ፤ ዐምዶሙ ፡ ፫ምዕማዶሙ ፡ ፫ ።
verses.translation: And for the second side the height of the curtains shall be of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

translations.lxx: And for the second side the height of the curtains shall be of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translations.kjv: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
translations.ron: Şi la celălalt capăt cincisprezece coţi să fie perdele la fel, cu trei stâlpi ai lor şi cu trei postamente.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸ κλίτος τὸ δεύτερον δεκαπέντε πήχεων τῶν ἱστίων τὸ ὕψος· στύλοι αὐτῶν τρεῖς, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τρεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወለመድረከ ፡ ዐጸዳ ፡ መንጦላዕታ ፡ ፳ኑኁ ፡ በእመት ፡ ዘያክንት ፡ ወሜላት ፡ ወነት ፡ ወቢሶስ ፡ ክዑብ ፡ ብዑደ ፡
                  ይኩን ፡ በግብረ ፡ መርፍእ ፤ አዕማዲሁ ፡ ፬ወመዓምዲሁ ፡ ፬ ።
verses.translation: And a veil for the door of the court, the height of it of twenty cubits of blue linen, and of purple, and spun scarlet, and of fine linen spun with the art of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

translations.lxx: And a veil for the door of the court, the height of it of twenty cubits of blue linen, and of purple, and spun scarlet, and of fine linen spun with the art of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
translations.kjv: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
translations.ron: Iar la mijloc, poarta curţii, largă da douăzeci de coţi, să aibă perdele de lână violetă, stacojie şi vişinie, răsucită şi de în răsucit, cu patru stâlpi şi patru postamente.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῇ πύλῃ τῆς αὐλῆς κάλυμμα· εἴκοσι πήχεων τὸ ὕψος ἐξ ὑακίνθου, καὶ πορφύρας, καὶ κοκκίνου κεκλωσμένου, καὶ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης τῇ ποικιλίᾳ τοῦ ῥαφιδευτοῦ· στύλοι αὐτῶν τέσσαρες, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν τέσσαρες.

verses.geez: ኵሉ ፡ ኤዕማድ ፡ ዘዐጸድ ፡ ይዑዱ ፡ ይትቀፈሉ ፡ ቅፍሎ ፡ ብሩር ፤ ወአርእስቲሆሙኒ ፡ ብሩር ፤ መዓምዲሆሙ ፡ ብርት ።
verses.translation: All the pillars of the court round about overlaid with silver, and their chapiters silver and their brass sockets.

translations.lxx: All the pillars of the court round about overlaid with silver, and their chapiters silver and their brass sockets.
translations.kjv: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
translations.ron: Toţi stâlpii curţii împrejur să fie ferecaţi cu argint şi uniţi cu legături de argint, iar postamentele lor să fie de aramă.
translations.grk: Πάντες οἱ στύλοι τῆς αὐλῆς κύκλῳ κατηργυρωμένοι ἀργυρίῳ, καὶ αἱ κεφαλίδες αὐτῶν ἀργυραῖ, καὶ αἱ βάσεις αὐτῶν χαλκαῖ.

verses.geez:
ወኑኀ ፡ ዐ[ጸ] ዱ ፡ ፻በእመት ፡ ወፅፍኁ ፡ ፶ወቆሙ ፡ ዘኅምስ ፡ በእመት ፡ እምብሶስ ፡ ክዑብ ፡ ወመዓምዲሆሙ ፡ ብርት
                  ።
verses.translation: And the length of the court shall be a hundred cubits on each side, and the breadth fifty on each side, and the height five cubits of fine linen spun, and their sockets of brass.

translations.lxx: And the length of the court shall be a hundred cubits on each side, and the breadth fifty on each side, and the height five cubits of fine linen spun, and their sockets of brass.
translations.kjv: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
translations.ron: Aşadar lungimea curţii să fie de o sută de coţi, lăţimea peste tot de cincizeci de coţi, înălţimea de cinci coţi, perdelele să fie de în răsucit, iar postamentele stâlpilor de aramă.
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ μῆκος τῆς αὐλῆς ἑκατὸν ἐφʼ ἑκατόν· καὶ εὖρος πεντήκοντα ἐπὶ πεντήκοντα· καὶ ὕψος πέντε πήχεῶν ἐκ βύσσου κεκλωσμένης, καὶ βάσεις αὐτῶν χαλκαῖ.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ ግብሩ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መጋብርቲሁ ፡ ወታክልተ ፡ ዐጸዱ ፡ [ብርት] ።
verses.translation: And all the furniture and all the instruments and the pins of the court shall be of brass.

translations.lxx: And all the furniture and all the instruments and the pins of the court shall be of brass.
translations.kjv: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
translations.ron: Toate lucrurile, toate uneltele şi toţi ţăruşii curţii să fie de aramă.
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶσα ἡ κατασκευὴ καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐργαλεῖα καὶ οἱ πάσσαλοι τῆς αὐλῆς χαλκοῖ.

verses.geez:
ወንተ ፡ አዝዞሙ ፡ ለውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይንሥኡ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ ዘዘይት ፡ ዘቀዳሜ ፡ ቅሥመታ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ውጉአ ፡
                  ለብርሃን ፡ ከመ ፡ ያኅትው ፡ ማኅቶተ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ በቤተ ፡ መቅደስ ።
verses.translation: And do thou charge the children of Israel, and let them take for thee refined pure olive-oil beaten to burn for light, that a lamp may burn continually

translations.lxx: And do thou charge the children of Israel, and let them take for thee refined pure olive-oil beaten to burn for light, that a lamp may burn continually
translations.kjv: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
translations.ron: Să porunceşti fiilor lui Israel să-ţi aducă untdelemn curat pentru luminat, stors din măsline, ca să ardă sfeşnicul în toată vremea, în cortul adunării, în faţa perdelei celei de dinaintea chivotului legii.
translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ σύνταξον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ λαβέτωσάν σοι ἔλαιον ἐξ ἐλαιῶν ἀτρυγον καθαρὸν κεκομμένον εἰς φῶς καῦσαι, ἵνα καίηται λύχνος διαπαντός

verses.geez:
አፍአ ፡ እመንጦላዕት ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ትእዛዝ ፡ ወያኀትው ፡ አሮን ፡ ወደቁ ፡ እምሰርክ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነግህ ፡ በቅድመ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሕገ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ፡ ለትውልድክሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: in the tabernacle of the testimony, without the veil that is before the ark of the covenant, shall Aaron and his sons burn it from evening until morning, before the Lord: it is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations of the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: in the tabernacle of the testimony, without the veil that is before the ark of the covenant, shall Aaron and his sons burn it from evening until morning, before the Lord: it is a perpetual ordinance throughout your generations of the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Sfeşnicul îl va aprinde Aaron şi fiii lui, de seara până dimineaţa, înaintea Domnului. Aceasta e lege veşnică pentru fiii lui Israel din neam în neam".
translations.grk: ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ τοῦ μαρτυρίου· ἔξωθεν τοῦ καταπετάσματος τοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς διαθήκης καύσει αὐτὸ Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἀφʼ ἑσπέρας ἕως πρωῒ, ἐναντίον Κυρίου, νόμιμον αἰώνιον εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.
